description: Source code for SHA1-HMAC cryptographic driver for Linux kernel, implementing HMAC with SHA1, including key setup, transformation, finalization, and hardware interaction functions.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_transform
methods.description: Saves input block to context, handles dbn workaround.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_setkey
methods.description: Sets SHA1 HMAC key, supports keys longer than 64 bytes.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_setkey_hw
methods.description: Stores SHA1 HMAC key into hardware registers.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_final
methods.description: Finalizes SHA1 HMAC and outputs result.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_final_impl
methods.description: Computes final or intermediate SHA1 HMAC value, interacts with hardware.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_init_tfm
methods.description: Initializes pointers in SHA1 HMAC transform.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_exit_tfm
methods.description: Frees pointers in SHA1 HMAC transform.
